title: Full finite scalar-adjunct implication
statement: For a prime invertible on W, integral source S, finite source objects Q_n, generator maps g_n and a boundary delta to comparison units, define sheafKummerClassCondition as follows. For every level and residue-linear degree-two class e, if the actual full scalar adjunct of e along g_n equals the negative product of delta with the positive compared Kummer unit, the finite-class predicate holds for the actual exact-functor image of e in p-adic coefficients. This is the literal scalar-adjunct implication of the diagonal tower calculation; it makes no existence assertion and chooses no data.

def sheafKummerClassCondition (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (hW : IsUnit (ℓ : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (S : DiagonalAb W)
    (Q : ∀ n, Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n)))
    (g : ∀ n, S ⟶ (cartierForget (diagonalResidue.{u} ℓ n) W).obj (Q n))
    (δ : Ext.{u + 1} S ((comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} W).obj W.gmSheaf) 1)
    (finiteClass : sheafKummerFinitePredicate ℓ W Q)
    : Prop
